claims.answer: King Mode supplies a King PM with orchestrator, complex-task and simple-task model roles. A user converses with the PM in one chat while the product shows live task progress and the PM reports results; follow-ups queue at the next PM break. The product-owned King PM plans, spawns and tracks tasks rather than merely displaying a native CLI subagent tree. Existing licensed users open King Mode from the dashboard/project penguin icon and provide a goal.

sources.title: KingCoding: home
sources.locator: Discontinued headline, Availability archive and existing-user continuation
sources.finding: The owner says development and new sales ended, no new purchases or license issuance remain, and existing license verification/key resend continue. The page remains a project archive. It gives no exact end/announcement date.

sources.title: KingCoding: download
sources.locator: Existing user download, license verification and Mac Apple Silicon link
sources.finding: The current download is restricted to existing customers and requires the email/key from their prior purchase. It offers Mac Apple Silicon.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs
sources.locator: Overall Flow; Prerequisite Install a CLI; first task
sources.finding: Exact adapter documentation says the Mac app drives installed Claude Code or Codex CLI, detects them on PATH and allows per-task selection.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-tasks
sources.locator: Anatomy, create/run, execution modes, completion and history
sources.finding: Tasks are persistent project-owned requests with running, waiting, review and completed states, inline follow-up/approvals and retained history.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-king-mode
sources.locator: What King Mode is; workflow; model roles; follow-ups
sources.finding: The product-owned King PM plans a goal, spawns tasks in parallel, tracks live progress and reports back in one chat, with queued follow-up instructions.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-tunnel-mobile
sources.locator: Overview, setup, Mobile-Specific UI and Avoiding Mac Sleep
sources.finding: Tailscale Serve exposes the running local app to authorized tailnet devices. The mobile browser can create/follow/reply to tasks. The Mac must remain awake.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-license
sources.finding: Retained legacy docs describe a full-feature trial that becomes read-only without activation, and one paid license per Mac. Their purchase instruction is superseded by the current end-of-sales notice.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-ai-options
sources.locator: Choosing a Provider; Gemini API Key for Fast Title / Commit Generation
sources.finding: Claude Code/Codex are task harnesses. The optional Gemini API key is for titles/commit messages, not evidence of Gemini CLI integration.

sources.title: KingCoding: docs-updates
sources.finding: Retained documentation describes in-app updates and local SQLite data, but gives no dated current release/changelog entry.
